# END INPUT PROGRAM

End an input program and run it.

## Syntax

```text
END INPUT PROGRAM.
```

## Example

```text
INPUT PROGRAM.
LOOP #i = 1 TO 5.
COMPUTE x = #i.
END CASE.
END LOOP.
END FILE.
END INPUT PROGRAM.
```

`statscraft help END INPUT PROGRAM` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
